lines.trans: I have a very simple question for you.
From one head chef to another?
Which of my cooks came to see you?
I do not rat out my people, Viktor.
He is my cook, not yours!
He wants to work in a good kitchen.
I have the best kitchen in this city!
Then why are your people looking for work?
I will definitely find out his name myself!
It is time for me to go to the kitchen.
Will you find the way out yourself?
I will, I remember the way very well.
Wonderful then, all the best to you!
